Package neqsim.chemicalreactions.chemicalreaction

Enum Class ChemicalReactionDataSource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ChemicalReactionDataSource>
neqsim.chemicalreactions.chemicalreaction.ChemicalReactionDataSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ChemicalReactionDataSource>, Constable
public enum ChemicalReactionDataSource extends Enum<ChemicalReactionDataSource>
Identifies the database source used to load a thermodynamic system's chemical reactions.

A source identifies a reaction set and its equilibrium-constant parameters. It does not imply that the parameters are valid for another thermodynamic model or standard-state convention.
